run_heatmap_and_tracking: run heatmap and tracking on a video using YOLO detection and ByteTrack with configurable thresholds
create_heatmap_annotator: create a HeatMapAnnotator with configurable position, opacity, radius, and hue range for overlaying heat maps on video frames
create_byte_tracker: create a ByteTrack tracker with activation threshold, lost track buffer, and matching threshold for object tracking across frames
process_video_frames: process video frames with YOLO person detection, tracking, heatmap annotation, and label annotation to produce an output video
download_sample_video: download a sample people-walking video asset from Roboflow Supervision for testing heatmap and tracking pipelines
